description: Create a SHARED memory room — a space OTHER people's assistants can read, and write too when their membership scope is read_write, across the AI tools members connect to Mnemoverse. Members can access the room's existing history, including memories saved before they joined; joining does not expose their private account memory. Use when the user wants to share context or collaborate with someone else (e.g. 'make a room for me and my teammate'). Returns the room's address; pass that address as the `domain` on memory_write/memory_read to use it, and on memory_list_recent to catch up on what others added. People join through an invite minted with memory_invite_to_room.

name.description: Room name, unique within your account (e.g. 'launch-team').

name: memory_create_room

address.description: Domain address (xroom:<id>); pass as `domain` on read/write.

room_id.description: The room's id (room_...); pass to memory_invite_to_room.
